 Coram : M.M. Sathaye, J.
Date : 21st August, 2025 P.C. :
1.

This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with CR No. 175 of 2023 registered with Rabodi Police Station, Thane for offence punishable under Section 328, 272, 273 of IPC and Section 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(e) and 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
It is informed that Section 328 of IPC is invoked later on.
2. The FIR is dated 19.08.2023 and the Applicant is the sole accused.
According to the FIR, the contraband articles in the form of Gutkha was found stored in a godown owned by the Applicant and therefore the FIR is filed.
3. Learned Counsel for the Applicant submits that the issue as to whether Section 328 of IPC can be applied to storage of Gutkha, is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.

He submits that the 63-ABA-2849-2023.doc Applicant has been co-operating with the investigation and is also protected since 10.10.2023 under order of this Sharif Ahmed Shafiq Ahmed Alvi vs The State Of Maharashtra on 21 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179718097/
1 Court.
4. Learned APP on instructions of officer of the concerned Police Station who is present in the Court, submits that charge-sheet is already filed including for the Applicant.

entities.text: Sharif Ahmed Shafiq Ahmed Alvi vs The State Of Maharashtra on 21 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is informed that case is registered as Sessions Case No. 62 of 2005 in the Sessions Court of Thane.

5. Considering the nature of allegations and the fact that issue about application of Section 328 of IPC to matters involving Gutkha is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court and further considering that the charge-sheet is already filed and that Applicant has been protected for long time under the order of this Court, case for grant of anticipatory bail is made out.
6. The application is allowed in terms of order dated 10.10.2023.
The Applicant is directed to attend the trial regularly unless exempted by the concerned Trial Court.
7. The application is disposed of in above terms.

(M.M. SATHAYE, J.)
